prompt: audit the pasted blog post — severity-graded findings + before/after rewrites

assertions.text: Output contains all 4 required sections: Summary, Detailed findings, Revised sections, Legal/compliance flags
Detailed findings table uses severity labels (High/Medium/Low)
Flags lead-gen CTA (sign up, free trial, book a demo) in legal or findings
Flags deprecated platform framing in favor of research lab positioning
Provides at least 3 before/after revisions for highest-severity issues
Flags persona mismatch (101-level language for expert audience)
